description: Pattern launcher — eight buttons, each holding three voltages, with the change from one to the next held back until the next measure arrives

params.text: Queues that pattern; it takes over on the next pulse at the STEP input, and until then the lamp is red for queued and green for running
Sets the voltage the PTN output sends while that pattern is running, 0V to 10V; it comes up spread evenly across the eight so it can select a pattern on another sequencer
Sets the voltage the CV1 output sends while that pattern is running, 0V to 10V
Sets the voltage the CV2 output sends while that pattern is running, 0V to 10V
Switches the eight pattern outputs between a gate held high for as long as that pattern is running, and a 1ms trigger at the moment it takes over

inputs.text: A pulse here brings in whichever pattern has been queued; patch a bar or measure clock in so patterns change in time

outputs.text: The PTN voltage of the running pattern
The CV1 voltage of the running pattern
The CV2 voltage of the running pattern
10V while that pattern is the running one, or a 1ms pulse at the moment it takes over, depending on the GATE/TRIG button

notes: a pattern button only queues that pattern; it takes over on the next rising edge at the STEP input, so with nothing patched there the running pattern never changes

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
